verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a GPU cloud console, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no first-party assistant inside the Lambda Cloud console or docs. The only agentic tooling is an unofficial third-party CLI/MCP server built by a community developer, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
